value.title: Empowering {city} Businesses
value.description:
At {business} we're passionate about empowering local businesses to thrive in the digital age. We understand that in today's competitive digital landscape, effective marketing strategies are essential for your success. That's where we come in.

Our journey began with a simple yet powerful idea: to harness the potential of indoor digital billboards and help local businesses reach their full potential. With a focus on innovation, creativity, and results, we've become a trusted partner for businesses across {city}, {state}.

While we specialize in indoor digital billboards, our expertise extends far beyond that. From website design to robust multichannel campaigns, we offer a full suite of services designed to elevate your brand and drive results.

Our strategy, your brand. Together, let's build something great.

value.title: Ernie Vidal, Founder & Owner
value.description:
I'm Ernie Vidal, Founder & Owner of Digi Plus Marketing LLC. I bring more than eight years of experience in social media and digital marketing, along with a background in healthcare administration. My work includes content creation, advertising, website design, and helping small businesses build a stronger online presence.

I founded Digi Plus Marketing in 2024 to make effective marketing more affordable and accessible for local small businesses. My mission is to help business owners gain visibility, attract customers, and compete with larger brands, while building a lasting business for my family.

Since launching, I've expanded our services to include indoor digital billboards, geofencing, streaming TV advertising, social media management, Google Business Profile management, and website services. Developing our indoor billboard network has been a key focus, giving local businesses consistent exposure and opportunities to cross-promote throughout the community.

I'm based in Bloomfield, New Jersey, and serve businesses throughout Essex County and surrounding communities, including Montclair and West Orange. Building relationships with local business owners and supporting our community's growth are central to my work. I serve as Stage Manager and Indoor Advertising Specialist for the Essex-Union MNO networking chapter, and I'm a member of Be Intentional Mastermind Academy and the Suburban Essex Chamber of Commerce.

Outside of work, I enjoy cycling, cricket, soccer, and staying active. I also participate in the Montclair Bikery Thanksgiving charity ride, which helps provide turkeys for families in need.
